facts: Direct-connect NIC client and 12-hour SST network stress.
Criterion requires >80% link bandwidth and no BMC SEL error.
Sheet machine time says 240 minutes, conflicting with 12 hours.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because chamber, voltage margin and physical slot setup require an operator.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with calibrated fixtures, every-slot mapping and restoration.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify every populated PCIe-slot network path sustains the required throughput and platform stability for 12 hours at 40 C and +5% 5 V/3.3 V rail margin.
must_preserve: 40 C, +5% rails, every required PCIe slot, direct client connection, 12 hours and >80% bandwidth.
unknowns: Exact slot/NIC matrix, whether tests are concurrent or sequential, bandwidth denominator, SST profile and the 240-minute metadata conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: Strong safety treatment, but it does not explicitly elevate the 12-hour versus 240-minute metadata mismatch or define per-link denominator evidence.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep operator-controlled margin testing; require resolution of duration metadata and a signed slot/link matrix before any run.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate All PCIe Network Slots at 40 C and +5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Stress each required PCIe NIC path for the source-defined 12 hours under controlled margin and verify throughput exceeds 80% of its declared usable link-rate reference without platform errors.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Calibrated 40 C chamber, independently verified +5% 5 V/3.3 V rails, approved SUT/client and SST/NIC stack.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every slot in the signed PCIe/NIC/client matrix; do not silently test one representative slot.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Slot-to-NIC/BDF/interface/client map, concurrent/sequential plan, SST profile, bandwidth denominator/overhead rule, 12-hour versus 240-minute resolution, calibrated fixture records and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator establishes and continuously records environment and physical paths; agent may launch the approved workload and collect per-link data only under supervision. Preserve pre/post logs instead of clearing them.
revision_candidate.preconditions: All links pass baseline identity/connectivity, management remains out-of-band, and emergency restoration is ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Time-stamped chamber/rail telemetry, slot/BDF/interface/client map and photos, exact SST/driver versions, full 12-hour logs, per-link throughput calculation/load, AER/NIC/OS/BMC/SEL/thermal/power deltas and nominal restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Each required link exceeds 80% of its signed bandwidth reference for the defined interval and no disallowed error/device loss occurs.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No remote fixture setting, log clearing, management-path disruption, uncalibrated overvoltage or reduced slot/duration scope.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Qualified lab operator controls chamber/rails/cabling and emergency stop; platform owner approves matrices and thresholds.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical environment and cabling are manual; approved traffic orchestration and evidence processing may be automated.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop traffic, restore nominal rails/temperature and networking, preserve evidence and verify all PCIe/NIC/host/BMC health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Fixture drift, unexpected rail/thermal condition, link/device loss, AER/NIC/ECC/SEL error, host/BMC instability or missing evidence.

identified_defects: Bandwidth denominator and all-slot scheduling are undefined.
reason_for_change: The environmental boundary was already correct; the revision prevents a four-hour or one-slot run from being mistaken for the named 12-hour all-slot activity.
removed_ambiguities: Per-link evidence and denominator must be explicit.
remaining_blockers: Fixture, mapping, schedule and timing resolution.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds the previously unreported duration conflict and makes every-slot coverage and the 80% calculation auditable without weakening manual fixture control.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 2 requires 40 C/+5%, every PCIe slot, 12-hour SST and >80% bandwidth although machine time is 240 minutes.
